name: Central Bank of Ireland Consumer Protection Code 2026
reference: Central Bank (Supervision and Enforcement) Act 2013 (Section 48(1)) (Conduct of Business) Regulations 2025 + Central Bank Consumer Protection (Standards for Business) Regulations 2025

chapters.title: Vulnerable Customers + Consumers in Financial Difficulty

articles.title: General Principles
articles.requirement: 12 General Principles applying to all regulated financial service providers (RFSPs): act honestly + fairly + in customers' best interests; act with due skill, care + diligence; manage conflicts of interest; communicate in a way that is clear, fair + not misleading; have effective governance + resources; identify + support vulnerable customers; safeguard customer assets; maintain appropriate records.

articles.title: Standards for Business — Acting in Customers' Best Interests
articles.requirement: RFSPs must act in their customers' best interests. Functions as the firm-level analogue of the Common Conduct Standard 4. Embedded into product design, distribution, pricing, communications + ongoing relationship management.

articles.title: Standards for Business — Securing Customer Interests Outcomes
articles.requirement: RFSPs must take steps to deliver: (a) products + services that meet identified target-market needs; (b) fair value; (c) clear understanding; (d) appropriate support throughout the lifecycle. Outcomes-focused, mirroring (but not identical to) the UK Consumer Duty's four outcomes.

articles.title: Securing Customer Interests — Target market + product oversight
articles.requirement: Manufacturers must define a target market for each product + ensure design meets its needs. Distributors must ensure distribution strategy is consistent with the manufacturer's target market. Product oversight + governance (POG) framework required. Periodic review of product outcomes.

articles.title: Securing Customer Interests — Fair Value Assessment
articles.requirement: RFSPs must conduct a Fair Value Assessment: price paid is reasonable relative to the benefits the customer would reasonably expect. Documented; refreshed periodically; available for CBI inspection. Distributor remuneration / fees assessed for value impact.

articles.title: Securing Customer Interests — Clear Communications
articles.requirement: All communications clear, fair + not misleading. Tailored to the audience (retail, vulnerable, professional); pre-contract information disclosed in good time. Where complexity is high, key information document or equivalent + comprehension safeguards required.

articles.title: Effective Governance Arrangements
articles.requirement: RFSPs maintain governance + oversight arrangements proportionate to size, complexity + risk: board + senior management responsibility for embedding Securing Customer Interests; MI + outcome monitoring; annual board review; clear allocation of accountability (interfaces with SEAR Prescribed Responsibilities).

articles.title: Frauds, Scams + Financial Abuse
articles.requirement: RFSPs must take reasonable steps to identify + mitigate fraud, scams + financial abuse affecting customers. Includes: APP fraud + impersonation-scam controls; customer education; warning + intervention triggers at suspicious-transaction risk points; victim support + reimbursement consideration; recordkeeping; mandatory reporting; cooperation with industry / law-enforcement initiatives.

articles.title: Vulnerable Customers
articles.requirement: Definition: a customer who, due to personal circumstances, is especially susceptible to detriment (ill health, life events, low capability, low financial resilience). RFSPs must identify, record + support vulnerable customers — adjustments to communications, products, processes; trained staff; specialised support channels; review + escalation triggers.

articles.title: Consumers in Financial Difficulty
articles.section: Conduct Regs Pt VI (+ MARP + SFS)
articles.requirement: Strengthened Mortgage Arrears Resolution Process (MARP) + Standard Financial Statement (SFS) for consumers in arrears or pre-arrears. Forbearance options assessment; affordability + sustainability tests; communication standards; protection from inappropriate enforcement action; signposting to MABS / advice services.

articles.title: Mortgages
articles.requirement: Lifecycle requirements for mortgages: pre-contract information + the European Standardised Information Sheet; affordability + suitability assessments; switching support; arrears handling (MARP); buy-to-let carve-outs; carry-over of consumer protections under the CCMA + the Code of Conduct on Mortgage Arrears.

articles.title: Insurance + Cards + Payments
articles.requirement: Insurance — claims handling standards, product oversight, demands + needs assessment, conflicts of interest for intermediaries. Cards + Payments — PSD2/PSR-aligned authorisation + transparency requirements; APP-fraud protections incorporated.
